overview.story: The Senior Living Citizens Foundation was conceived with one question: where do India's seniors go when the city becomes too fast, too loud, and too far from the doctor? Built on freehold registered land near Reliance MET City, Kheri Asra brings together 64 residential plots, 9 boutique G+2 residences, and an integrated Ayurvedic healing hospital.
